title: Kaikoura UFO incident

tellings.quote: there was a really big UFO incident in 1978 when I was 16 years old in a place called Kaikoura on the east coast of the South Island of New Zealand

plain: In 1978 there was "a really big UFO incident" at Kaikoura, on the east coast of New Zealand's South Island, according to the Australian journalist Ross Coulthart. He tells Michels he was 16 at the time and remembers it, but he only names the event and does not describe what was seen.
